Description: A gentle opening. Nobody expects much of you yet.
Notes: A DIALOGUE BEFORE A FIXTURE. Story names a Dialogue.csv scene and it plays on the way to the team sheet, before you pick anybody - which is the only moment a scene can change your mind about who to field. Leave it blank and the fixture goes straight there. A fixture's Story plays every time it is played; use flag:x in the scene if it should only happen once.

Description: The pit apprentices. All pace and no patience.
They sing you to sleep, then score.
Notes: Difficulty 1 gives every one of their cards +1 attack and +1 defence.

Description: Fourth of eleven. The table starts to matter.
Notes: On Win runs the same words as Progression.csv - unlock:x, count:x+n, flag:x, announce:Text

Description: Halfway. They have not lost at home in two years.
Big, slow, and very hard to move.
The harbour side. They play the whole match in your half.
Young and quick and completely fearless.
The last league game. Win it and you go in confident.
Notes: Difficulty 3 is as high as you should go - cards are 0-5 power.

On Loss: announce:So close. There is always next season.
Notes: Final=true ends the season. Class is BLANK here, so the opponent is a surprise.

Description: The season decider. Only reachable once you have beaten the Marsh King in Adventure.
Notes: WORKED EXAMPLE - THE SEASON READS ADVENTURE. Requires gates a fixture the same way it gates anything else.
